Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 18

“One who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among people — disciplined, and performing every action.”

The chapter's central paradox and its resolution in one line. The ending saves it: this person is doing everything, not sitting still while claiming inner detachment.
